description: Analyze one to 25 buyer-supplied transaction sizes against a per-transaction fee cap. plan=budget_sats:vbytes[,vbytes...], e.g. 1000:140,220,350. Uses fresh node fee estimates, rounds up to whole sats, and returns the fastest observed estimate fitting each cap. Estimates do not guarantee confirmation. No transaction is signed or broadcast. Price: 20 sats or US$0.01 (USDC) per call.

l402.description: Optional. After paying the Lightning invoice: '<token>:<preimage>'.

pass.description: Optional. A Diamond budget token (dp_...) that your user approved once (from US$0.89; USDC or other Base tokens, or Lightning) or that you funded with the free diamond_budget tool. Each call deducts its price; no wallet needed in the agent.

pay_with.description: Optional. 'lightning' returns a BOLT11 invoice and a token instead of the x402 payment request.

plan.description: Per-transaction fee cap in sats, colon, and one to 25 comma-separated transaction sizes in vbytes. Example 1000:140,220,350. Fee cap 1..100000000; each size 60..100000.

name: analyze
title: Batch transaction fee budget analysis
